seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed. Reusing a seed does not guarantee identical results, because the prompt is expanded before generation.

images.title: Images
images.description: Up to 8 input images to edit or combine. Leave empty for text-to-image generation. When using several images, refer to each by what it shows in the prompt.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Instruction describing the image to generate, or the edit to make. For edits, say what should change and what should stay the same.

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the output. 'auto' picks the framing from your input images and prompt.

regional_edit.title: Regional Edit
regional_edit.description: Experimental. Change only the parts of the image that need to change and keep the rest unchanged. Needs at least one input image. Quality may be lower and generation slower than a regular edit.

thinking_mode.title: thinking_mode
thinking_mode.description: How much planning happens before generation. 'fast' is quicker and works for most requests. 'high' plans complex or multi-step edits more carefully, but is slower and costs more.

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: What to avoid in the output.
